_note: Curated date-night venues and events in Bellingham, WA. Researched 2026-11-04 from venue sites, bellingham.org, Cascadia Daily News, Whatcom Kid Insider and ticketing pages. Confidence: high = venue's own site/social confirms; medium = third-party listing. The weekly AI scout refreshes this once deployed.

venues.name: Bellingham Sportsplex
venues.description: Indoor ice rink (home of the Bellingham Blazers) with public skate sessions, skate rentals and learn-to-skate programs. Schedule varies weekly; call (360) 676-1919.

venues.name: The Racket Bar & Pinball Lounge
venues.description: 21+ no-cover pinball bar next to The Shakedown with the largest pinball lineup in town (~14 machines), cocktails and IFPA-sanctioned tournaments.

venues.name: 1-Up Lounge
venues.description: Retro-modern arcade bar with consoles, pinball and arcade cabinets plus pizza, cocktails and craft beer. 18+ after 7 p.m.

venues.name: 20th Century Bowl
venues.description: Classic downtown bowling alley with bar and arcade; reopened Nov 2025 after roof repairs. Open bowling Fri/Sat, leagues Sun-Thu. Roughly $4.50-5/game + $3 shoes.

venues.name: Park Bowl
venues.description: Bowling center with Splitz Grille restaurant, arcade and lounge on north Meridian.

venues.name: Bellingham Axe
venues.description: Indoor axe-throwing venue with private lanes and interactive target games; voted a top date-night spot. Open Wed-Thu 5-9, Fri 5-11, Sat 1-11, Sun 1-9.

venues.name: Vital Climbing Gym
venues.description: Bouldering gym with yoga and fitness area; walk-in day pass $24 includes a class. Open daily 11am-9pm.

venues.name: The Eureka Room
venues.description: Downtown escape room with multiple themed rooms (about 60 minutes each).

venues.name: Cryptid Escapes
venues.description: Fairhaven escape room venue from the owners of The Eureka Room, with themed rooms (murder mystery, spaceship, rock-and-roll backstage).

venues.name: Flatstick Pub
venues.description: Golf-themed pub with a 9-hole indoor mini-golf course, duffleboard and tabletop games plus WA craft beer. 21+ after 9 p.m.

venues.name: Aegis Games & Taphouse
venues.description: Board game taphouse with a large game library, Catan league and Geeks Who Drink trivia.

venues.name: Pickford Film Center
venues.description: Nonprofit independent cinema showing art-house, foreign, documentary and repertory films, plus Third Eye Cinema cult films Saturdays at 10 p.m. ($10).

venues.name: Regal Barkley Village 16 IMAX & RPX
venues.description: 16-screen first-run multiplex with IMAX and RPX screens in Barkley Village.

venues.name: Mount Baker Theatre
venues.description: Historic 1927 performing arts theatre hosting touring Broadway, concerts, comedy and speakers on its Main Stage, plus intimate Lookout Sessions in the 150-seat Walton Theatre.

venues.name: Bellingham Theatre Guild
venues.description: Community theatre in a historic church producing five mainstage shows a season (tickets ~$8-19). Holiday show opens Nov 27, 2026.

venues.name: The Upfront Theatre
venues.description: Improv comedy theatre with Thursday-Saturday shows, drop-in classes and the annual Bellingham Improv Festival.

venues.name: Wild Buffalo House of Music
venues.description: Bellingham's main touring-act club: reggae, funk, hip hop, electronic and dance nights; mostly 21+.

venues.name: The Shakedown
venues.description: Rock/punk/metal club with shows most nights of the week, attached to The Racket pinball lounge.

venues.name: The Blue Room
venues.description: All-ages downtown music and arts venue with concerts, comedy nights, jam sessions and dance parties.

venues.name: Honey Moon Mead & Cider
venues.address: 1053 N State St (in the alley), Bellingham, WA 98225
venues.description: Cozy meadery/cidery tucked in an alley with live acoustic music almost nightly and a Wednesday open mic.

venues.name: Aslan Depot
venues.description: Aslan Brewing's barrel-aged beer bar in a former depot with free weekly jazz, live music, open mic and themed trivia.

venues.name: FireHouse Arts & Events Center
venues.description: Converted firehouse hosting Jazz Center of Bellingham concerts, film series, recitals and community events.

venues.name: Hotel Leo
venues.description: Historic hotel with the Amendment 21 lounge and Crystal Ballroom; Thursday happy-hour jazz, Sunday jazz jam and ballroom dance events.

venues.name: Stones Throw Brewery
venues.description: Fairhaven brewery with free live music Wed/Fri/Sat, Thursday trivia, board game and movie nights.

venues.name: Schweinhaus Biergarten
venues.description: German-style indoor/outdoor beer garden with weekly karaoke (Tue), trivia (Wed) and open jam (Thu).

venues.name: Rumors Cabaret
venues.description: Bellingham's LGBTQ+ bar and dance club: DJ dance floor with light show nightly until 2 a.m., karaoke Mon/Thu, drag shows. Happy hour daily 4-7.

venues.name: Red Rum Tiki Bar
venues.description: Tiki cocktail bar with Thursday karaoke (one of the city's most popular) and Sunday trivia.

venues.name: Cap Hansen's
venues.description: Classic downtown dive bar with one of Bellingham's longest-running karaoke nights (Sunday).

venues.name: Archer Ale House
venues.description: Basement British-style pub in Fairhaven with Thursday karaoke and Sunday trivia.

venues.name: Beach Cat Brewing
venues.description: Taproom near the waterfront with Thursday trivia, music bingo, cribbage, Magic nights, comedy and bi-weekly Saturday karaoke.

venues.name: Kulshan Brewing - K2 Roosevelt Taproom
venues.description: Large production brewery taproom with Wednesday trivia ($2) and food trucks.

venues.name: Kulshan Brewing - Sunnyland Taproom
venues.description: Kulshan's original taproom with Tuesday trivia and rotating food trucks.

venues.name: Penny Farthing at Chuckanut Bay Distillery
venues.description: Cocktail bar inside Chuckanut Bay Distillery with Tuesday trivia.

venues.name: Stemma Brewing West
venues.description: Stemma's second taproom with Wednesday Country Night (line-dance lesson), Thursday trivia and Monday run club.

venues.name: Broadway Hall
venues.description: Historic hall that hosts B'ham Hop's weekly Wednesday swing dance with a beginner Lindy Hop lesson.

venues.name: Fairhaven Library (Bellingham Country Dance Society)
venues.description: Upstairs auditorium hosts community contra dances with live bands and callers on 2nd/4th/5th Saturdays, Sept-June.

venues.name: Viking Union, Western Washington University
venues.description: WWU Salsa & Bachata Club hosts a free Monday salsa lesson and social in the Viking Union Multipurpose Room, open to non-students.

venues.name: Depot Market Square

venues.name: Downtown Bellingham
venues.description: Downtown Bellingham Partnership events: First Friday art walk, wine walks and seasonal festivals.

venues.name: Whatcom Community College Syre Theater
venues.description: Auditorium on the WCC campus used for film tours, lectures and performances.

venues.name: WWU Performing Arts Center
venues.description: Western Washington University's concert hall and theatres: orchestra, choir, jazz and student productions.
